The link to this GitHub repository is given below:https:\/\/github.com\/bstabler\/TransportationNetworks?tab=readme-ov-fileMany of the networks in the above GitHub repository are for studying the Traffic Assignment Problem, which is one of the most basic problems in transportation research. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only.
